A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BevSplat work. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison covered all 29 pages of each version, including Appendices A–O, without material gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original KITTI and VIGOR localization results, component ablations, multi-frame experiments, and appendix robustness analyses.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experiments and appendix analyses, with revised VIGOR results in Table 2.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same Gaussian generation, feature extraction, BEV rendering, confidence-guided matching, and training losses. The multi-frame procedure is also unchanged.

E1.justification: KITTI and VIGOR coverage is unchanged, including same-area/cross-area evaluation, orientation scenarios, multi-frame localization, and synthetic rain, fog, and night conditions.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains Boosting, CCVPE, HC-Net, DenseFlow, and G2SWeakly as comparators. Comparator membership in the KITTI evaluations and appendix experiments is also unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported splits, metrics, orientation conditions, supervision settings, training budgets, and testing procedures remain unchanged. No protocol revision accompanies the Table 2 score changes.

E4.justification: The component ablations, primitive-count sensitivity, multi-frame analyses, depth-estimator comparisons, weather robustness tests, and failure cases are unchanged, including their appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Both versions retain checklist item 7 stating that formal statistical-significance analysis is absent; neither adds repeated-run information or uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises 12 BevSplat VIGOR scores under unchanged reported settings. For lambda1=1 with aligned orientation, same-area mean/median errors change from 2.62/1.40 to 2.87/1.58 m, and cross-area errors from 2.63/1.38 to 2.84/1.36 m. The revisions mix higher means with lower cross-area medians; KITTI and appendix results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations 1–9, the Gaussian formulation, loss definitions, and Appendix C gradient derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same method contribution and broad localization-accuracy claims. The narrower benchmark interpretation appears in Section 4.1 and Table 2.

C2.justification: Section 4.1 and Table 2 replace the claim of superior VIGOR same-area performance against supervised methods with comparable performance. The cross-area interpretation and existing mechanism explanations and limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v4 adds a repository address and states that code is available in the abstract, supplementing v3's release commitments. Implementation details are unchanged. The checklist still promises later code/data release, leaving release completeness unresolved from the PDFs.

R1.justification: The related-work sections and cited works are unchanged. There is no revision to the method's novelty positioning or substantive relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: Edits are limited to affiliation capitalization, the abstract's code sentence, the VIGOR comparison paragraph, and an acknowledgment adding ShanghaiTech's HPC Platform. Section organization and appendix prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2 updates its caption and best-score bold highlighting. The acknowledgment causes limited page-11 reflow. Figures and table structures are retained, and every appendix page is visually identical.

improvement.justification: The repository pointer improves access information, and the narrower VIGOR same-area interpretation better reflects the revised Table 2 ranking against supervised methods. These are modest reporting gains. The score revisions are unexplained, and the unchanged checklist leaves code availability inconsistently described, limiting the reproducibility improvement established by the PDFs.
